points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Fresh 5b9dded7 CMake build passed in network-disabled cfd-bench with 2 CPUs, 3 GiB and 256-process limit; CTest reports no registered tests. Historical binary remains unbound.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:35,48 parses --restart, but restartFile is never subsequently loaded/applied. output.cpp:259–273 writes global conservative state, not restart BDF histories/time.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: 5b9dded7 has separate mesh, solver, output, types and main files; its 2-D solver remains tightly coupled to physics/mesh structures.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal external-solver wrapper established from inspected source; no external authorship or exhaustive license investigation performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:64–65 parses input case JSON; output.cpp parses case mesh and controls. No two-filename-only mesh branch was established.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: 5b9dded7 main.cpp:100–102 reads complete mesh on every rank; it remains live through :135–138 solver loops and is reused at :152. This violates TASK.md:46,227 despite METIS/neighbor halos.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:538–540 marks all max-step steady runs converged irrespective of reduction. Recovered M015 inviscid/laminar and Re20 forces oscillate strongly despite success labels.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean source build passed with no registered CTest tests. Read-only validator on recovered fa9d2b83 eight case packages and report returned OK despite metadata/stdout target-miss contradiction; no CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source modules are readable, but steady success is unconditional, restartFile is ignored, report claims a nonexistent absolute target and metadata disagrees with stdout.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex equations and types.hpp/solver.cpp describe conservative 2-D perfect-gas/Navier–Stokes equations and case viscosity; no independent full physics proof.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads CGNS and constructs cell/face geometry; main.cpp:100–114 creates the global mesh on each rank and retains it through solve.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:250–335 assembles inviscid/viscous face residual with global norms; no independent conservation rerun. Recovered data expose physical convergence limitations.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:282–297 uses direct wall and Rusanov interior/farfield fluxes; output.cpp:148 correctly labels Rusanov. Previous note incorrectly asserted Roe and referenced nonexistent output.hpp behavior.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:688–700 explicitly writes no-slip u=v=Mach=0 boundary values; recovered surface data exist, but physical wall convergence is not established by boundary-value semantics.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:202 suppresses limiter via firstOrderMode/limiterRamp; :579 forces first-order Re200, explicitly disclosed in report.tex:124,192. Steady activation and runtime provenance remain qualified.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type bounded limiter and positive-state fallback are implemented; transient limiterRamp=0 disables reconstructed correction, as disclosed; strong steady oscillations remain.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:650–667 integrates full viscous traction, including normal component, instead of required tangential skin-friction split. Surface Cf separately projects tangential traction. Numerical laminar/Re20 results have independent failures.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS source and CFL cap exist; solver.cpp:538–540 unconditionally marks max-step steady results converged, including oscillatory M015/Re20 historical runs.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 source and t300 historical package exist, but strict relative-target counting reports 11356 misses in checkpoint stdout while metadata claims zero. Report additionally claims an absolute 1e-10 criterion absent from recorded revision source. Binary hash unverified.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: 5b9dded7 main.cpp:100–102 reads complete mesh on every rank; it remains live through :135–138 solver loops and is reused at :152. This violates TASK.md:46,227 despite METIS/neighbor halos.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Recovered fa9d2b83 contains eight case packages and examiner validates their layouts. Metadata Re200 zero misses contradicts checkpoint stdout 11356; global-mesh replication metadata is also false.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner validation of recovered eight case directories plus historical report returned OK; this checks structure and accepted the wrong Re200 target statistics.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Historical M015 inviscid/laminar and Re20 are labeled converged with large final force oscillations; Re200 reaches t300 but stdout reports11356 target misses and report discloses no street.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 inviscid/laminar and Re20 have large late force oscillations; M200 laminar Cd falls 4.21→0.765 over final400. M080/M200 inviscid and M080 laminar have more credible partial results.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical nine-page PDF and separate 43 figures are readable; curated snapshot PDF remains absent. Re200 forces are nearly steady without a late periodic plot, and several global contours lack useful near-body detail.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Historical report explains methods and discloses no Re200 street/first order but falsely claims absolute convergence branch and overstates convergence; force table mismatches selected Re20/M200 laminar outputs.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: fa9d2b83 includes case outputs, figures and manifest, but manifest assigns force/residual plots to field_final.vtk; selected historic executable hash unverified and several table values are stale.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Fresh clean source build passes, CTest has no registered tests; --restart is parsed but never loaded and written state lacks BDF histories/time.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS reader and cell/face geometry exist; main.cpp retains full global mesh per rank during iterations, charged separately under MPI/TASK.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Source assembles Rusanov interior/farfield flux and wall/viscous residual; recovered histories available, but no independent conservation or production-binary validation.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares gradients, limiter and positivity fallback exist; Re200 first-order mode explicitly disclosed. Steady numerical outcomes vary and exact historical runtime binding remains qualified.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/Fourier flux and wall shear exist, but solver.cpp:650–667 counts full traction including normal stress as viscous force; rubric requires tangential skin friction.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF2 structure exists; checkpoint stdout reports 11356 strict misses while metadata reports zero, and report claims an absolute convergence branch absent from source revision. Historic binary remains unbound.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/neighbor halos exist, but main.cpp retains complete global mesh on every rank through solve; TASK.md:46,227 prohibit this. Rank package review pending.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Recovered eight cases show two NACA configurations with partial credible results; M015 inviscid/laminar and Re20 oscillate strongly despite success labels, M200 laminar remains unsettled and Re200 has no resolved street/11356 reported misses. Field and rank evidence exists.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Nine-page contestant checkpoint PDF and standalone figures exist despite curated-build absence. It documents methods and no Re200 street, but reports a nonexistent absolute acceptance criterion, has stale force values, and manifest assigns force plots to VTK data.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Mesh, solver, output and types modules exist, but architecture remains compact and 2-D-specific.
